QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Defeat the Lion King
QuestInfo.0: Preparations are complete. It is time to eliminate the Lion King. Talk to #b#p2161002##k.
QuestInfo.1:
Head to the Audience Room and defeat the transformed Lion King on easy mode. He once was a normal warrior, only skilled with the sword, but no one knows what he's capable of now under the influence of the Black Mage. If you're alone, this will be a tough battle.

#o8840000##r #a31711##k
QuestInfo.2: You have defeated Von Leon, the Lion King. However, with the power of the Black Mage preserving him, it is impossible to eliminate him entirely. In addition, according to the Lion King, the forces of the Black Mage are looming closer to Maple World.

0.0: Are you prepared? With the #t2030021# in your hands, you only have one thing left to do. Go to the #bAudience Room#k and #reliminate the monster who was once my king#k. This is for him...

yes.0: The king I knew was a normal warrior who was skilled with a sword, but not much else. Under the Black Mage's influence, I don't know what he's capable of. I doubt you can defeat him on your own. I recommend you gather some people to help you.

no.0: There is no other way. It's been hundreds of years since the Black Mage disappeared, but he hasn't recovered. I'm tired of waiting.

1.0: Did you defeat him? I see... I feel saddened for my king. I don't know how it came to this. I used to serve the king with utmost loyalty...

yes.0: This is all because of the Black Mage. You haven't completely defeated the king, you know. With the power of the Black Mage, he is only temporarily weakened. The source of his power is tied to the Black Mage, so he will not truly fall until that power has been driven from his body.

mob.0: Have you not gone to face #rhim#k yet? His skilled swordmanship was recognized by all. If the Black Mage has made him stronger, he won't be an easy opponent. Gather some people to help you fight him.
